However, global supply and investment in critical minerals fall short, exacerbated by declining ore quality, concentrated production in a few countries, and rising environmental and cost pressures. Innovation and technology adoption across the mining value chain is essential to identify new resources, enhance efficiency, reduce environmental impacts, and diversify supply.
